run_all_torchvision_models_evaluation: run the script to predict parameters and evaluate all torchvision models on CIFAR-10 or ImageNet
run_ghn_parameter_prediction: run GHN2 to predict parameters for a torchvision model architecture on a given dataset
run_infer_evaluation: run inference on a model using the infer utility to get top1 and top5 accuracy
run_capacity_check: run the capacity utility to count the number of parameters in a model
run_adjust_net_for_dataset: run adjust_net to adapt a torchvision model for large or small input datasets
